why: A story plan has tasks: the booking change grows, and the production setting is no longer needed.
message: The discussion settled on a default lifetime, so production needs no setting, and the expired error names the time it expired.
assumptions: A default of 24 hours is right for every environment that sets none.

items.title: Record when each quote expires
items.outcome: Every quote knows its expiry time, from the lifetime in the booking service's settings.
criteria: A quote's expiry time is its issue time plus the configured lifetime.
The booking service refuses to start when the lifetime is missing or isn't a positive duration.
The quote API returns each quote's expiry time.

task.context:
- `internal/booking/quote.go`: `Quote` has `IssuedAt`, set when the quote is created.
- `internal/booking/config.go`: `Config` holds the service's settings, read from the environment by `LoadConfig`.
- `internal/api/quotes.go`: `GET /quotes/{id}` returns a quote as JSON.
task.change:
- `internal/booking/config.go`: add `QuoteTTL`, read from `QUOTE_TTL` with `time.ParseDuration`. `LoadConfig` fails when it's missing, zero or negative.
- `internal/booking/quote.go`: add `Quote.ExpiresAt(ttl time.Duration) time.Time`.
- `internal/api/quotes.go`: add `expires_at` (RFC 3339, UTC) to the quote JSON.
definition_of_done: Tests added or updated for every changed behavior
task.test_plan:
- `internal/booking/config_test.go`: a missing, zero, negative or malformed `QUOTE_TTL` fails `LoadConfig`; `24h` gives 24 hours.
- `internal/booking/quote_test.go`: `ExpiresAt` is `IssuedAt` plus the lifetime.
- `internal/api/quotes_test.go`: the JSON has `expires_at`.

items.title: Refuse an expired quote at booking, saying when it expired
items.outcome: Booking an expired quote returns an expired error that says when it expired, with a link to a new quote, and books nothing.
criteria: Booking a quote before its expiry time works as it does today.
Booking a quote at or after its expiry time returns 410 with the code quote_expired and the expiry time, and books nothing.
The error's body links to a new quote for the same trip.
The MCP server's book tool returns the same error.

task.context:
- `internal/booking/book.go`: `Book` checks the quote's status and creates the booking in one transaction.
- `internal/api/errors.go`: `writeError` maps a booking error to a status and a code.
task.change:
- `internal/booking/book.go`: return `ErrQuoteExpired`, with the expiry time, when now is at or after `ExpiresAt`, before anything is written.
- `internal/api/errors.go`: map `ErrQuoteExpired` to 410 and `quote_expired`, with `expired_at` and a `new_quote` link.
definition_of_done: Tests added or updated for every changed behavior
task.test_plan:
- `internal/booking/book_test.go`: booking one second before the expiry time works; at it, and after it, gives `ErrQuoteExpired` with the expiry time.
- `internal/api/book_test.go`: the 410 body has `quote_expired`, `expired_at` and the `new_quote` link.

items.title: Set the quote lifetime in production
Give the quote lifetime a default
items.outcome: The booking service runs with a quote lifetime of 24 hours unless its settings give another.
criteria: With no lifetime in its settings, the booking service starts, and quotes expire after 24 hours.
A lifetime in its settings that isn't a positive duration still stops the service from starting.

task.change: - `internal/booking/config.go`: default `QuoteTTL` to 24 hours when `QUOTE_TTL` is missing; keep refusing a zero, negative or malformed one.
definition_of_done: Tests added or updated for every changed behavior
task.test_plan: - `internal/booking/config_test.go`: a missing `QUOTE_TTL` gives 24 hours; a zero, negative or malformed one fails `LoadConfig`.
